description:
The R Installation Manager

Install, remove, configure R versions.
- New rig proj sync --check option to check that the project
  environment is in sync with rproj.lock. It exits with status 1 if sync
  would install, update or remove any package, e.g. after packages were
  installed or removed by hand, and with status 2 on other errors (#495).
- rig proj lock --check now exits with status 2 on errors, e.g. if there
  is no rproj.toml, and keeps status 1 for a missing or out of date
  rproj.lock.
- rig proj sync --dry-run no longer fills in a missing .Renviron or
  .rvenvlib, it only says that sync would. It now fails if there is
  neither an rproj.toml nor an rproj.lock, like rig proj sync does.
- New rig add --no-default option to install an R version without
  making it the default when no default R version is set yet, and
  rig add --without-path to skip putting rig's quick-link directory on
  the PATH (the shell startup files on macOS and Linux, the user PATH on
  Windows). Tools that run rig to install R, like RStudio, can use them to
  leave the user's default R, quick links, PATH and IDE settings alone.
- rig list, rig add and other commands no longer fail on macOS in user
  mode when ~/.local/bin does not exist yet (#491).
- rig system clean-registry on Windows now removes all stale R and
  Rtools registry entries and "Add/Remove Programs" entries.
- rig list, rig add and other commands no longer fail with
  on macOS in user mode when ~/.local/bin does not exist yet (#491).
- rig on Linux now uses an updated embedded root certificate bundle
  (webpki-root-certs 1.0.10), which drops the compromised
  "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" root (see GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62).
- rig pkg install and rig proj sync now install git, GitHub and
  url:: package sources on Windows again. rig passed \\?\ paths
  to R CMD INSTALL, which R rejected (#485).
- rig proj import and rig proj lock now handle Remotes and
  Config/Needs/* entries for packages with a dot in their name, e.g.
  Rdatatable/data.table (#476).
- rig proj lock now keeps relative 'path' dependencies relative in the
  lock file. The root project is saved with path ".", if it is a package.
- rig proj import and rig proj export now convert all [build] entries
  to and from the ByteCompile, NeedsCompilation, LazyData, Biarch
  and KeepSource DESCRIPTION fields.
- rig proj status now reports whether rproj.lock is up to date with
  rproj.toml, e.g. after a manual edit of rproj.toml. It runs the same
  check as rig proj lock --check (#466).
- New prefer-binary and exclude-newer configuration entries (and
  RIG_PREFER_BINARY and RIG_EXCLUDE_NEWER environment variables) set the
  defaults of --prefer-binary and --exclude-newer for rig pkg install
  and the rig proj commands (#441).
- The project .Renviron now quotes the saved R_LIBS_USER value, so it
  works with Windows paths. Delete .Renviron and call rig proj lock
  to recreate it with the fixed version in existing projects.
- rig now sends a User-Agent header with its HTTP requests, e.g.
  rig/0.11.1 (+https://github.com/r-lib/rig).
- rig now supports authenticated repositories and Posit Package Manager
  instances. See the new "Authentication" guide.
- New rig pkg sync [LOCKFILE] command installs the packages of a lock file
  into a library, without touching the project environment.
- A new --cache-dir flag, RIG_CACHE_DIR environment variable, and
  cache-dir configuration entry allow overriding the location of rig's cache.
  --no-cache still takes precedence.
- Packages are now installed with file modes more closely aligned with those
  left by R CMD INSTALL. Existing packages in the cache are left unchanged.
- An R session that runs a different R minor version than the one the
  project was synced for now really leaves the project library alone.
  Before, rig printed a warning, but still activated the library (#450).
  Call rig proj sync in existing projects to update the activation code.
- The dependency solver now treats a dash in a package version the same as
  a dot, like R does, so e.g. version 0.3-3 satisfies >= 0.3.3 (#453).
- New rig proj lock --check and rig proj sync --locked options, to fail
  if rproj.lock is missing or out of date with rproj.toml, e.g. in CI
  (#411).
- rig pkg install now calls its --no-install-project option
  --no-install-self. The old name still works, as an alias (#442).
  rig proj sync accepts --no-install-self as an alias of
  --no-install-project.
